title: 番外II 紫虚异域日记V
content_zh:
一个月太阳没落山，紫虚表示自己已经无颜面对大汉仙人了，作为一个专精星相定位的仙人，先是星相一个不认识，之后来到这鬼地方，星相就一个，那就是太阳……
太阳不落山，你让我怎么观星，紫虚大怒着将封印好的舍利子从身体里面掏出来摔在冰面上，然后又接住，然而太阳就是不落山。
好在仙人不吃不喝，餐风饮露……饮个鬼露啊，这鬼地方根本就没有露水，风里面都带着冰碴子，一刮风就是七八级，还好紫虚实力暴强，不存在被冻死这种事情。
“叭嗒！”一个黑背白胸，一尺高不到两尺，不会飞看起来蠢萌蠢萌的鸟摔倒在紫虚面前，好吧，不会飞这一点简直是鸟类中的耻辱。
“拿去吃。”蹲在冰面上的紫虚面无表情的一跺脚，自己面前那块刚刚冻了几尺的冰面又被紫虚狂的往出跳，简单来说就是找死。
自从蹲到这里之后，一开始这群蠢萌的鸟类还有些怕这个紫色的同类，不过时间久了，这群通灵的动物，发现对方是完全无害的，而且饿的抓狂的时候，倒在紫虚面前，紫虚身前的冰面就会
自然这群蠢萌蠢萌的企鹅将紫虚当成了某种自动捕鱼的东西，因而紫虚现在蹲的地方有很多企鹅，在冰面破碎之后，呼啦啦一群就挤着跳了下去。
“这地方到底是怎么回事，除了冰就是冰，动物都这几种。”紫虚将几个正在冰面边缘摇摇晃晃观望的企鹅踢下去抓鱼之后，单手撑着自己的脑袋一脸无语的自语道。
现在紫虚也不敢乱飞了，本身已经彻底失去方向了，再飞下去也只能是空耗心力了。
顺带紫虚靠着搜集到的材料和仙人的法力制造了一个真空悬浮指南针，然后飞到三千米的高空使用了这东西，这个真空悬浮指南针效果好到差点让紫虚以首叩地。
原因很简单，这个悬浮指南针指的方向是地上，讲道理在紫虚的印象之中，指南针指的是南北，结果现在直直的指着大地，紫虚有一种打人的冲动。
虽说他不像其他人那样智慧高绝，但是指南针指脚底下是什么鬼，虽说我智商没破二百，但是我也不是你想糊弄就能糊弄的。
紫虚开始还以为是因为那个地方有磁铁，然后深挖三千米，冰面都挖穿，挖出土，最后没挖出磁铁矿。
当时懵圈的紫虚就差点给那里树一个大冰山写上这里是极南，最后还是丢不起这个人，将冰山给砸了，然后将耗费了大量苦心制造的真空悬浮指南针给撇了，这种东西出了国看起来是不能用了。
之后紫虚就蹲在冰面上思考人生，思考了数月之后，紫虚突然发现自己的肤色出现了问题，从黄种人变成了白人，不过在这种恶劣情况下，作为没有真实身躯的仙人，不自我调节一下身体内气构成也不正常啊！
直到某一天，紫虚修炼完毕睁眼一看，天黑了……
当时紫虚的第一反应是，这地方居然还有天黑，第二反应是我到底修炼了多长时间。
好吧，这都不重要，重要的是天黑了意味着有星星了，有星星意味着自己能飞回去了。
兴奋的炸飞了冰山的紫虚抬头望天，满天星辰，没有一个自己认识的，好吧，这种情况也不是第一次遇到了，习惯就好了，没什么没有认识的就没有认识的，迷失方向什么习惯就好。
紫虚默默地安慰着自己，直到感官上过了几个月之后，天还是黑的，当然期间第一次见到极光的时候紫虚甚至以为是仙界的召唤，兴奋的朝着那里飞去，然而飞到紫虚吐了，那玩意都是可望而不及。

最后紫虚只能默默地认为仙界与自己无缘，每次蹲在冰山上看着极光叹息……
叹了三个月的息，每天两次看到仙界召唤自己，然而就是不得其门，实验了各种方式之后紫虚最后只能带着一颗被天界伤碎了的心默默地飞离开这个地方。
飞走的时候，飞一节回头一次，最后忍痛不回头，闭着眼睛朝着前方狂飞，以最高速度闭眼飞了一个时辰之后，紫虚睁眼的时候突然发现天亮了，所谓的绚丽的天界之门也消失了。
就像是之前的一切不过是一场梦一样，然而紫虚非常清楚的知道自己并不是做梦，自己的躯体变白了很多，内气也明显出现了为适应环境而诞生的冰属性效果。
“我感觉心好痛……”紫虚随意的回望了一个方向，“仙界之门啊，结果没摸到，唉，不过回去可以和南华他们吹嘘吹嘘了。”
紫虚缓缓地降低着飞行高度和飞行速度，这才注意到下方大片大片的森林，和中原相比，这里的的树木繁茂的可怕。
“没想到居然遇到了一处岛屿。”紫虚心情好了不少，不管怎么说，能遇到一处正常的岛屿也算好的，就算星相依旧诡异也没有什么，至少能遇到陆生动物啊！
你能想象，大半年时间不是水啊水啊啊，就是冰啊冰啊的，对于一个神智健全的仙人来说到底有多么恶心吗？可以说现在能有点不是蓝色，不是白色的东西，紫虚都快感激涕零了。
“呃……”这是什么声音，“青蛙？”紫虚侧耳倾听，隔了好久之后，听到了一声“呱”，那一刻紫虚简直都要感激涕零了，大半年没见过正常的生物了，海里的鱼都长得非常奇怪，何况是青蛙，他乡遇故知的节奏啊！
紫虚顺着声音兴冲冲的飞了过去，然后远远的就嗅到一股甜腻但是又有些发腥的怪味，不过没什么，为了他乡的故知，继续前进，青蛙什么的，对于大半年没见个正常动物的紫虚来说简直兴奋。
紫虚飞的速度并不快，顺着声音飞了十多里之后见到了一只，呃，一坨，也不对，总之那是一个让紫虚非常扭曲的青蛙。
蓝色黑斑，大概有三丈长，嘴角挂着的蛇尾巴，就知道这个青蛙完全不正常。
紫虚一脸懵圈的看着这只大约有三丈长的蓝色黑斑青……好吧，蓝蛙，总之这是一个让紫虚崩溃的玩意，不过看在对方叫的那么响亮，那么像他乡故知的份上，紫虚还是上前仔细观察了一下。
青……蓝蛙吃饱喝足的趴在雨林里面消化，在这片地方它没有天敌，每天除了吃就是打盹，不知不觉就长到这么大了，不过和正常青蛙一样，他看慢的东西没什么反应，快的东西反倒会激起兴趣。
紫虚飞行的速度不慢，自然蓝蛙也看到了，不过一方面蓝蛙刚刚吃饱，另一方面紫虚看起来貌似不怎么好吃，所以蓝蛙就趴在那里一动不动，对于紫虚这个大虫子当作没看到。
直到，紫虚处于好奇（zuosi）落在这只超巨型，超剧毒毒箭蛙的头上，这只常年作死吃蛇，但是一直没被蛇吃掉的毒箭蛙终于有了反应……
content_en:
It had been a month since the sun had set. Zixu said that he had no face to face the Han Immortal. As an Immortal who specializes in astrological positioning, he didn't recognize any of the astrology at first. Then when he came to this ghost place, there was only one astrology, and that was the sun...
How can I watch the stars if the sun doesn't set? Zixu angrily took out the sealed relic from his body and threw it on the ice, then caught it again, but the sun didn't set.
Fortunately, immortals do not eat or drink, but eat wind and drink dew... drink ghost dew. There is no dew in this damn place at all, and the wind is filled with ice particles. When the wind blows, it is level 7 or 8. Fortunately, Zixu is so powerful that there is no such thing as being frozen to death.
"Bata!" A bird with a black back and white chest, one foot tall and less than two feet tall, and a bird that couldn't fly and looked cute fell down in front of Zixu. Well, being unable to fly was simply a shame among birds.
"Take it and eat it." Zixu squatted on the ice and stamped his feet expressionlessly. The ice surface in front of him that had just been frozen for a few feet was jumped out by Zixu. Simply put, he was looking for death.
Since squatting here, these stupid and cute birds were a little afraid of this purple counterpart at first. However, as time went by, these psychic animals found that the other party was completely harmless, and when they were hungry and crazy, they fell in front of Zixu, and the ice in front of Zixu would
Naturally, this group of cute and cute penguins regarded Zixu as some kind of automatic fishing device, so there were many penguins where Zixu was squatting. After the ice broke, a group of them huffed and jumped down.
"What the hell is going on in this place? It's just ice, and there are all these kinds of animals." After Zixu kicked a few penguins who were teetering on the edge of the ice to catch fish, he supported his head with one hand and said to himself speechlessly.
Now Zixu doesn't dare to fly around anymore. He has completely lost his direction. If he continues to fly, it will only be a waste of energy.
By the way, Zixu relied on the collected materials and the magic power of the immortal to create a vacuum levitation compass, and then flew to an altitude of three thousand meters to use this thing. The effect of this vacuum levitation compass was so good that Zixu almost knocked his head to the ground.
The reason is very simple. The floating compass points to the ground. Logically speaking, in Zixu's impression, the compass points to north and south. But now it points straight to the earth. Zixu has an urge to hit people.
Although he is not as intelligent as others, the compass points to what is under his feet. Although my IQ is not over 200, you can't fool me if you want to.
Zixu initially thought it was because there were magnets in that place, so he dug three thousand meters deep, digging through the ice and digging out soil, but in the end no magnetite was found.
Zixu, who was confused at that time, almost planted a big iceberg there and wrote that this is the extreme south. In the end, he couldn't afford to lose this person, so he smashed the iceberg, and then threw away the vacuum suspension compass that took a lot of painstaking efforts to create. It seems that this kind of thing cannot be used outside the country.
After that, Zixu squatted on the ice and thought about life. After thinking for a few months, Zixu suddenly discovered that there was a problem with his skin color, from yellow to white. However, in this harsh situation, as an immortal without a real body, it is not normal for him not to self-regulate the composition of his body's energy!
Until one day, Zixu finished practicing and opened his eyes to see that it was dark...
At that time, Zixu's first reaction was that it was still dark in this place. His second reaction was how long I had been practicing.
Well, none of this is important. The important thing is that when it gets dark, it means there are stars, and the stars mean that you can fly back.
Zixu, who was so excited that he blew up the iceberg, looked up at the sky. The sky was full of stars, and none of them he recognized. Well, this was not the first time he encountered this situation. Just get used to it. If you don't know anything, you won't know anything. If you lose your way, just get used to it.
Zixu comforted himself silently until his sensesA few months later, the sky was still dark. Of course, when he saw the aurora for the first time, Zixu even thought it was a call from the fairy world, so he flew towards it excitedly. However, until Zixu vomited, it was out of reach.
In the end, Zixu could only silently think that the fairy world had no destiny for him, and sighed every time he squatted on the iceberg and looked at the aurora...
After sighing for three months, he saw the fairy world calling him twice a day, but he couldn't find the way. After experimenting with various methods, Zixu could only silently fly away from this place with a heart broken by the heaven.
When flying away, Fei turned back once every quarter, and finally endured the pain without looking back. He closed his eyes and flew forward wildly. After flying for an hour with his eyes closed at the highest speed, Zixu suddenly found that it was dawn when he opened his eyes, and the so-called gorgeous gate to heaven had disappeared.
It was as if everything before was just a dream, but Zixu knew very clearly that he was not dreaming. His body had turned a lot whiter, and his inner energy had obviously developed the ice attribute effect that was born to adapt to the environment.
"I feel so heartbroken..." Zixu looked back in one direction casually, "The gate to the fairy world, but I didn't touch it. Alas, I can brag about it with Nan Hua and the others when I go back."
Zixu slowly lowered his flying altitude and speed, and then he noticed the vast forests below. Compared with the Central Plains, the trees here were terrifyingly lush.
"I didn't expect to encounter an island." Zixu felt a lot better. Anyway, it was good to encounter a normal island. Even if the stars were still weird, it didn't matter. At least he could encounter terrestrial animals!
Can you imagine how disgusting it is for a sane immortal to spend more than half a year living in water or ice? It can be said that now there is something that is not blue or white, and Zixu is almost bursting with gratitude.
"Uh..." What is this sound, "frog?" Zixu listened carefully. After a long time, he heard a "croak". At that moment, Zixu almost burst into tears with gratitude. He hadn't seen a normal creature for more than half a year. The fish in the sea looked very strange, let alone frogs. The rhythm of meeting an old friend in a foreign land!
Zixu flew over excitedly following the sound, and then smelled a sweet but fishy smell from a distance, but it was nothing. For the sake of old friends from a foreign land, he continued to move forward. Frogs and other things were very exciting for Zixu, who had not seen a normal animal for more than half a year.
Zixu didn't fly very fast. After following the sound for more than ten miles, he saw a, uh, a lump, that's not right. In short, it was a frog that made Zixu very distorted.
The blue and black spots, about three feet long, and the snake's tail hanging from the corner of its mouth, tell you that this frog is completely abnormal.
Zixu looked at this blue and black-spotted green frog that was about three feet long in confusion. Well, blue frog, in short, this was a thing that made Zixu collapse. However, seeing that the other party screamed so loudly and looked like an old friend from a foreign land, Zixu stepped forward and took a closer look.
Green... The blue frog lay down in the rainforest to digest after eating and drinking. It had no natural enemies in this place. It only ate and took naps every day. It grew to this size without realizing it. However, like a normal frog, it didn't react to slow things, but fast things piqued its interest.
Zixu's flying speed was not slow, and naturally the blue frog also saw it. However, on the one hand, the blue frog had just eaten, and on the other hand, Zixu didn't seem to be very tasty, so the blue frog just lay there motionless, pretending not to see the big bug like Zixu.
Until, out of curiosity, Zixu landed on the head of this super giant, super poisonous poison dart frog. This poison dart frog, which has been trying to die by eating snakes for many years, but has never been eaten by snakes, finally reacted...
